verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's OpenPGP card docs show on-device key generation and touch confirmation on the Nitrokey 3. The product page lists an OpenPGP smart card, and the docs have a Thunderbird section, which covers keeping keys on the device and using them for encrypted email. Missing for 10: any documentation or hands-on evidence of git commit signing, any independent corroboration of the OpenPGP email workflow, and evidence beyond doc section headings.
